eventDecisions.name: 吉比特
eventDecisions.reason: Regulatory access reopened after eight months; Gigabit had strong 2021 revenue/profit/cash growth and a directly affected publishing ecosystem. The two-name game basket had +10.5% 20d excess but ~0% 60d excess, so timing is neutral rather than obviously over-absorbed. Policy scarcity and title-specific monetization keep it Research.

eventDecisions.name: 牧原股份
eventDecisions.reason: Eight-week hog-price recovery plus breeding-capacity contraction creates a direct price-minus-cost bridge; Muyuan had scale and improving unit cost, while the stock basket was still weak over 20d. However Q1 remained deeply loss-making and company-level profit conversion was not yet realized, so Research only.
The cost reversal is real but customers were also repricing downward. Without evidence that a specific company retains the input-cost benefit, the event fails the company margin-capture gate.
This is a downside demand filter. It can invalidate export-manufacturing theses but does not itself provide a clean positive A-share expression.
